# Device API v3.1 -- reference

Generated from `tools/api_spec.py`. The protocol itself (framing, verbs, status codes, dispatch order, subscriptions, bulk transfers, the transports) is described in [api-v3-spec.md](api-v3-spec.md); this page lists every resource.

This is API version **3.1** (System IDENTITY reports `api_version` = 3 and `api_minor` = 1). Every resource lists the version that introduced it in the *Since* column, and a field added to an existing payload later is marked *(since API x.y)*; `3.0` is the baseline of the versioning scheme (everything that existed when 3.1 was cut). Rules: [api-v3-spec.md](api-v3-spec.md), section 11.

Opcode = `[verb:4][category:4][resource:8]`, little-endian on the wire. Every response payload starts with a status byte; the tables below describe what follows an OK status. Little-endian, IEEE-754 floats. Largest payload: 122 bytes.

| Cat | Name | Verbs | What |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0x0 | [System](#system) | GET, SET | Identity, live device state, health and the real-time clock. |
| 0x1 | [Commands](#commands) | EXECUTE | One-shot actions. |
| 0x2 | [Calibrations](#calibrations) | GET, SET | Constants that correct a sensor or a measurement. |
| 0x3 | [Settings](#settings) | GET, SET | Behaviour: how often tasks run, thresholds, timeouts. |
| 0x4 | [Measurements](#measurements) | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | Single values. |
| 0x5 | [Topics](#topics) | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | Fixed bundles of related values, read or pushed atomically. |
| 0x6 | [Debug log](#debug-log) | SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | The device log, streamed live (Services/svc_log.c). |
| 0x7 | [Diagnostics](#diagnostics) | GET | Counters and registers for investigating the acquisition chain. |
| 0x8 | [Bulk transfers](#bulk-transfers) | START_BULK, CANCEL_BULK | Large RAM-buffered transfers streamed in chunks under the START opcode, paced by the transport's transmit ring. |
| 0x9 | [Procedures](#procedures) | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | Status and results of multi-second procedures started with a command. |

## System

Category 0x0. Verbs: GET, SET.

Identity, live device state, health and the real-time clock. Read-only except the RTC.

| ID | Name | Verbs | Since | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | IDENTITY | GET | 3.0 | Who and what is this: firmware, protocol version, serial number |
| 0x01 | STATE | GET | 3.0 | Live state: battery, connections, charging, rails and which activities are running |
| 0x02 | HEALTH | GET | 3.0 | Self-test results, error latches, communication counters, uptime and reset cause |
| 0x03 | RTC | GET, SET | 3.0 | Date and time |

Who and what is this: firmware, protocol version, serial number.

### System RTC (0x0/0x03)

Date and time. The clock has a 1/256 s sub-second counter, so drift can be measured to well under 1 ppm over a day (see Calibrations RTC_TRIM).

### Commands POWER_OFF (0x1/0x40)

Enter Standby now (wake: encoder press or USB plug-in). Answers first, then sleeps.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2140

Request payload: none.

### Commands REBOOT (0x1/0x41)

Software reset. Answers first, then resets.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2141

Request payload: none.

### Commands REBOOT_DFU (0x1/0x42)

Reset into the ROM USB bootloader (VID 0x0483 / PID 0xDF11). Sets the nBOOT0 option byte to 0: the device STAYS in the bootloader on every boot until reflashed with nBOOT0 restored (`STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=USB1 -w fw.hex -ob nSWBOOT0=1 nBOOT0=1 -v -rst`, or dfu_flash.ps1).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2142. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Request payload: none.

### Commands FORCE_CHARGE (0x1/0x43)

Charge regardless of the state of charge while USB power is present, until full or USB removal.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2143

Request payload: none.

### Commands END_CHARGING (0x1/0x44)

Cancel an armed forced charge. Does not stop normal automatic charging (use CHARGE_INHIBIT).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2144

Request payload: none.

### Commands CHARGE_INHIBIT (0x1/0x45)

Hold charging off (also cancels a forced charge). Stays in effect until cleared; not cleared by a USB replug.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2145

**Request** (1 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `inhibit` |  | 1 = inhibit, 0 = allow |

### Commands TILT_DEMOD (0x1/0x50)

Start or stop the tilt demodulation (runs from boot). BUSY_EXCLUSIVE while a bulk capture owns the ADC. The phasor stream is only a tap on the demodulation, so a stop ends its batches until the next start.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2150

**Request** (1 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `run` |  | 1 = run, 0 = stop |

### Commands ZERO_CAL (0x1/0x51)

Flip (zero) calibration, the 180-degree reversal test. Step 1 averages the reading in the current orientation (optionally only the selected sensors), step 2 after turning the instrument 180 degrees averages again and stores the new zero of those sensors (Calibrations S1_ZERO / S2_ZERO). Progress: Procedures ZERO_CAL.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2151. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Request payload: 1..2 bytes.

**Request** (2 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `action` |  | 0 cancel, 1 step 1, 2 step 2 |
| 1 | u8 | `sensor_mask` |  | step 1 only, optional: bit0 S1, bit1 S2 (default 3 = both) |

### Commands PRECISION (0x1/0x52)

Triggered precision measurement: one reliable value from the first clean 2 s window within 5 s, else an error. Needs the demodulation running; BUSY_RESOURCE during a zero calibration. Result: Procedures PRECISION.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2152

**Request** (1 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `action` |  | 0 start, 1 cancel |

### Commands FACTORY_DEFAULTS (0x1/0x60)

Reset ALL settings and calibrations to the compiled defaults and save them. Wipes the tilt calibrations: use with care.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2160. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

**Request** (1 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `confirm` |  | must be 0xA5 |

### Commands SERVICE_END (0x1/0x62)

Leave service mode now (it also ends by itself, see the protocol document). Entering it is only possible on the instrument: SETTINGS screen, Service mode.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2162

Request payload: none.

### Commands CLEAR_COUNTERS (0x1/0x61)

Zero the communication, drop and fault counters and the sticky error latches (settings_save_failed).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2161

Request payload: none.

### Commands TEST_BEEP (0x1/0x70)

Sound the buzzer for 100 ms.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2170

Request payload: none.

### Commands POWER_TEST (0x1/0x71)

Power investigation: each bit of the mask keeps one subsystem on, cleared bits cut it immediately. Boot default is all bits set.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2171. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

**Request** (4 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u32 | `mask` |  | bit0 5V rail, 1 3V3 rail, 2 AD9833, 3 ADS131M04, 4 BLE, 5 display, 6 LEDs, 7 CPU busy-loop (0 = WFI between ticks) |

**Response** (4 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u32 | `applied_mask` |  |  |

### Commands PIN_TEST (0x1/0x72)

Drive the six MCU-to-level-converter lines as static outputs. Arming is irreversible without the reboot bit.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2172. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

**Request** (1 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `pins` |  | bits 5..0: SCK, MOSI, CS, DISP_ON, VCOM, BUZZER; bit6 allow DISP_ON high (panel MUST be unplugged); bit7 reboot to normal |

### Commands FAULT_TEST (0x1/0x76)

Provoke a failure on purpose, to prove the fault capture and the watchdog on a bench (answers first, then misbehaves). 1: a HardFault (recorded, then the instrument resets; System HEALTH shows it after the reboot). 2: the main loop hangs with interrupts running (the supervised watchdog resets after about 3 s; reset_cause shows a WWDG reset). 3: a hang with interrupts disabled (the hardware watchdog resets within about half a second).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2176. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

**Request** (1 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `kind` |  | 1 HardFault, 2 main-loop hang, 3 hang with interrupts off |

### Commands EXCITATION (0x1/0x74)

Investigation: switch the AD9833 excitation on or off and set its PHASE0 register (phase reversal). Not persistent: every boot starts with the excitation on, phase 0.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2174. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

**Request** (3 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `on` |  | 1 = output on, 0 = output off (the DDS is held in reset) |
| 1 | u16 | `phase` | 360/4096 deg | PHASE0 register, 0..4095 = 0..360 degrees |

### Commands ADC_MUX (0x1/0x75)

Investigation: set the ADS131M04 input multiplexer of the selected channels. A running demodulation is restarted around the change (readings are invalid for about 2 s afterwards). BUSY_EXCLUSIVE during a bulk capture. Not persistent: every boot starts with all channels normal.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2175. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

**Request** (2 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `channel_mask` |  | bit n = ADC channel n (ch0 = S2, ch1 = B, ch2 = A, ch3 = S1), at least one bit |
| 1 | u8 | `mux` |  | 0 normal (input pins), 1 inputs shorted, 2 positive DC test signal, 3 negative DC test signal |

### Commands RAIL (0x1/0x73)

Switch one supply rail (shortcut for POWER_TEST bits 0 and 1).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2173. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

**Request** (2 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `rail` |  | 0 = 3V3 rail, 1 = 5V rail |
| 1 | u8 | `on` |  | 1 on, 0 off |

**Response** (4 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u32 | `applied_mask` |  | the resulting POWER_TEST mask |

### Commands EXC_FREQ (0x1/0x77)

Investigation: choose the excitation frequency f0 = 20833.33 Hz / n (n = samples per carrier cycle; n = 8, 2604 Hz, is the default and every boot's value). Sets the AD9833 frequency word to round(2^20 / n), switches the demodulation to n positions per cycle and restarts a running demodulation (readings are invalid for about 2 s). The batch stays 64 cycles, so its period is 64 n / 20833.33 s and the cycle counter in the phasor stream counts cycles of 1/f0. The calibrations (k, zero, phase) are valid at n = 8 only. BUSY_EXCLUSIVE during a bulk capture. Not persistent.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `EXECUTE` = 0x2177. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

**Request** (1 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `n` |  | samples per carrier cycle, 4..16 |

## Calibrations

Category 0x2. Verbs: GET, SET.

Constants that correct a sensor or a measurement. Stored in EEPROM; every SET persists immediately. IDs by group: 0x40 tilt sensors, 0x50 battery, 0x60 temperature, 0x70 clock.

| ID | Name | Verbs | Since | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0x40 | S1_K | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor 1 sensitivity k at PGA 1: tilt [mm/m] = (ratio - zero) / k [100 .. 1000000 1e-6 per mm/m] (service mode) |
| 0x41 | S1_ZERO | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor 1 zero (level point) as a ratio, independent of k [-500000 .. 500000 ppm of the ratio] (service mode) |
| 0x42 | S1_PHASE | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor 1 phase of the tilt signal relative to the excitation reference [-18000 .. 18000 0.01 deg] (service mode) |
| 0x43 | S1_INVERT | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor 1 sign of the reported reading (1 = inverted) [0 .. 1] (service mode) |
| 0x44 | S2_K | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor 2 k at PGA 1 [100 .. 1000000 1e-6 per mm/m] (service mode) |
| 0x45 | S2_ZERO | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor 2 zero [-500000 .. 500000 ppm of the ratio] (service mode) |
| 0x46 | S2_PHASE | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor 2 phase [-18000 .. 18000 0.01 deg] (service mode) |
| 0x47 | S2_INVERT | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor 2 sign of the reported reading [0 .. 1] (service mode) |
| 0x48 | S1_PGA | GET, SET | 3.0 | ADC PGA gain of sensor 1 (S1, ADC ch3), a power of two (1, 2, 4  [1 .. 128] (service mode) |
| 0x49 | S2_PGA | GET, SET | 3.0 | ADC PGA gain of sensor 2 (S2, ADC ch0), a power of two [1 .. 128] (service mode) |
| 0x4A | A_PGA | GET, SET | 3.0 | ADC PGA gain of excitation A (ADC ch2), a power of two; applied immediately [1 .. 128] (service mode) |
| 0x4B | B_PGA | GET, SET | 3.0 | ADC PGA gain of excitation B (ADC ch1), a power of two; same remark as A_PGA [1 .. 128] (service mode) |
| 0x50 | VBAT_SCALE_NUM | GET, SET | 3.0 | Battery divider scale numerator (Vbat = Vadc * num / den + offset) [1 .. 10000] (service mode) |
| 0x51 | VBAT_SCALE_DEN | GET, SET | 3.0 | Battery divider scale denominator [1 .. 10000] (service mode) |
| 0x52 | VBAT_OFFSET | GET, SET | 3.0 | Battery voltage offset [-500 .. 500 mV] (service mode) |
| 0x60 | TMP236_SEG1_VOFFS | GET, SET | 3.0 | TMP236 segment 1 voltage offset [0 .. 3300 mV] (service mode) |
| 0x61 | TMP236_SEG1_NUM | GET, SET | 3.0 | TMP236 segment 1 slope numerator [1 .. 10000] (service mode) |
| 0x62 | TMP236_SEG1_DEN | GET, SET | 3.0 | TMP236 segment 1 slope denominator [1 .. 10000] (service mode) |

| 0x64 | TMP236_SEG2_VOFFS | GET, SET | 3.0 | TMP236 segment 2 voltage offset [0 .. 3300 mV] (service mode) |
| 0x65 | TMP236_SEG2_NUM | GET, SET | 3.0 | TMP236 segment 2 slope numerator [1 .. 10000] (service mode) |
| 0x66 | TMP236_SEG2_DEN | GET, SET | 3.0 | TMP236 segment 2 slope denominator [1 .. 10000] (service mode) |
| 0x67 | TMP236_SEG2_TINFL | GET, SET | 3.0 | TMP236 segment 2 inflection temperature [0 .. 20000 0.01 degC] (service mode) |
| 0x68 | LM35_SCALE | GET, SET | 3.0 | External LM35 scale [1 .. 1000 mV per degC] (service mode) |
| 0x70 | RTC_TRIM | GET, SET | 3.0 | Clock trim: positive makes the clock run FASTER [-4800 .. 4800 0.1 ppm] (service mode) |

### Calibrations S1_K (0x2/0x40)

Sensor 1 sensitivity k at PGA 1: tilt [mm/m] = (ratio - zero) / k

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0240, `SET` = 0x1240. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `i32` in 1e-6 per mm/m, range 100 .. 1000000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S1_ZERO (0x2/0x41)

Sensor 1 zero (level point) as a ratio, independent of k

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0241, `SET` = 0x1241. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `i32` in ppm of the ratio, range -500000 .. 500000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S1_PHASE (0x2/0x42)

Sensor 1 phase of the tilt signal relative to the excitation reference

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0242, `SET` = 0x1242. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `i16` in 0.01 deg, range -18000 .. 18000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S1_INVERT (0x2/0x43)

Sensor 1 sign of the reported reading (1 = inverted)

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0243, `SET` = 0x1243. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u8`, range 0 .. 1. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S2_K (0x2/0x44)

Sensor 2 k at PGA 1

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0244, `SET` = 0x1244. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `i32` in 1e-6 per mm/m, range 100 .. 1000000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S2_ZERO (0x2/0x45)

Sensor 2 zero

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0245, `SET` = 0x1245. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `i32` in ppm of the ratio, range -500000 .. 500000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S2_PHASE (0x2/0x46)

Sensor 2 phase

Value: `i16` in 0.01 deg, range -18000 .. 18000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S2_INVERT (0x2/0x47)

Sensor 2 sign of the reported reading

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0247, `SET` = 0x1247. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u8`, range 0 .. 1. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S1_PGA (0x2/0x48)

ADC PGA gain of sensor 1 (S1, ADC ch3), a power of two (1, 2, 4 ... 128); applied immediately, k stays stated for PGA 1

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0248, `SET` = 0x1248. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u8`, range 1 .. 128. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations S2_PGA (0x2/0x49)

ADC PGA gain of sensor 2 (S2, ADC ch0), a power of two

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0249, `SET` = 0x1249. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u8`, range 1 .. 128. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations A_PGA (0x2/0x4A)

ADC PGA gain of excitation A (ADC ch2), a power of two; applied immediately. The input range is +-1.2 V / PGA and A is already about 0.6 V peak at PGA 1: a higher gain clips

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x024A, `SET` = 0x124A. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u8`, range 1 .. 128. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations B_PGA (0x2/0x4B)

ADC PGA gain of excitation B (ADC ch1), a power of two; same remark as A_PGA

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x024B, `SET` = 0x124B. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u8`, range 1 .. 128. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations VBAT_SCALE_NUM (0x2/0x50)

Battery divider scale numerator (Vbat = Vadc * num / den + offset)

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0250, `SET` = 0x1250. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u16`, range 1 .. 10000. SET answers status only.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0260, `SET` = 0x1260. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0262, `SET` = 0x1262. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

TMP236 segment boundary

### Calibrations TMP236_SEG2_VOFFS (0x2/0x64)

TMP236 segment 2 voltage offset

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0264, `SET` = 0x1264. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u16` in mV, range 0 .. 3300. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations TMP236_SEG2_NUM (0x2/0x65)

TMP236 segment 2 slope numerator

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0265, `SET` = 0x1265. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u16`, range 1 .. 10000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations TMP236_SEG2_DEN (0x2/0x66)

TMP236 segment 2 slope denominator

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0266, `SET` = 0x1266. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u16`, range 1 .. 10000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations TMP236_SEG2_TINFL (0x2/0x67)

TMP236 segment 2 inflection temperature

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0267, `SET` = 0x1267. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u16` in 0.01 degC, range 0 .. 20000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations LM35_SCALE (0x2/0x68)

External LM35 scale

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0268, `SET` = 0x1268. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `u16` in mV per degC, range 1 .. 1000. SET answers status only.

### Calibrations RTC_TRIM (0x2/0x70)

Clock trim: positive makes the clock run FASTER. Applied by the RTC's digital calibration (0.954 ppm per step, range about +-488 ppm, rounded to the nearest step). Measure the error as (RTC time - reference time) / elapsed time over several hours (System RTC has 1/256 s resolution) and SET the opposite sign. The crystal drifts with temperature (about -0.034 ppm/degC^2 around its turnover point), so calibrate near the working temperature.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0270, `SET` = 0x1270. **Needs service mode** (`SERVICE_MODE_REQUIRED` otherwise; reading is always allowed)

Value: `i16` in 0.1 ppm, range -4800 .. 4800. SET answers status only.

## Settings

Category 0x3. Verbs: GET, SET.

Behaviour: how often tasks run, thresholds, timeouts. Stored in EEPROM; every SET persists immediately. IDs by group: 0x40 task periods, 0x50 battery, 0x60 user interface and power.

| ID | Name | Verbs | Since | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0x40 | TASK_SENSORS | GET, SET | 3.0 | Sensor task period [1 .. 1000 ms] |
| 0x41 | TASK_BLE | GET, SET | 3.0 | BLE task period [1 .. 250 ms] |
| 0x42 | TASK_USB | GET, SET | 3.0 | USB task period [1 .. 250 ms] |
| 0x43 | TASK_BATTERY | GET, SET | 3.0 | Battery task period [100 .. 10000 ms] |
| 0x44 | TASK_TEMPERATURE | GET, SET | 3.0 | Temperature task period [100 .. 60000 ms] |
| 0x50 | BATTERY_CRITICAL | GET, SET | 3.0 | Below this the instrument powers off (must stay below BATTERY_LOW) [2500 .. 3600 mV] |
| 0x51 | BATTERY_LOW | GET, SET | 3.0 | Below this the low-battery warning shows (must stay above BATTERY_CRITICAL) [3000 .. 4200 mV] |
| 0x52 | BATTERY_CHARGE_START | GET, SET | 3.0 | Below this, with USB power present, charging starts [3000 .. 4200 mV] |
| 0x53 | CHARGE_FULL_TIMEOUT | GET, SET | 3.0 | Stop charging after this long at a state-of-charge reading of CHARGE_FULL_SOC or more, or as soon as the charger reports STANDBY, whichever comes first (0 = never) [0 .. 1440 min] |
| 0x54 | CHARGE_FULL_SOC | GET, SET | 3.0 | State-of-charge reading (voltage based) from which the CHARGE_FULL_TIMEOUT timer runs [50 .. 100 %] |
| 0x60 | AUTO_POWEROFF | GET, SET | 3.0 | Idle time with no encoder input before the instrument powers off (0 = never) [0 .. 65535 s] |
| 0x61 | ENCODER_COUNTS_PER_DETENT | GET, SET | 3.0 | Raw quadrature transitions per mechanical detent of the rotary encoders [1 .. 100] |

### Settings TASK_SENSORS (0x3/0x40)

Sensor task period

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0340, `SET` = 0x1340

Value: `u16` in ms, range 1 .. 1000. SET answers status only.

### Settings TASK_BLE (0x3/0x41)

BLE task period

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0341, `SET` = 0x1341

Value: `u16` in ms, range 1 .. 250. SET answers status only.

### Settings TASK_USB (0x3/0x42)

USB task period

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0342, `SET` = 0x1342

Value: `u16` in ms, range 1 .. 250. SET answers status only.

### Settings TASK_BATTERY (0x3/0x43)

Battery task period

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0343, `SET` = 0x1343

Value: `u16` in ms, range 100 .. 10000. SET answers status only.

### Settings TASK_TEMPERATURE (0x3/0x44)

Temperature task period

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0344, `SET` = 0x1344

Value: `u16` in ms, range 100 .. 60000. SET answers status only.

### Settings BATTERY_CRITICAL (0x3/0x50)

Below this the instrument powers off (must stay below BATTERY_LOW)

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0350, `SET` = 0x1350

Value: `u16` in mV, range 2500 .. 3600. SET answers status only.

### Settings BATTERY_LOW (0x3/0x51)

Below this the low-battery warning shows (must stay above BATTERY_CRITICAL)

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0351, `SET` = 0x1351

Value: `u16` in mV, range 3000 .. 4200. SET answers status only.

### Settings BATTERY_CHARGE_START (0x3/0x52)

Below this, with USB power present, charging starts

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0352, `SET` = 0x1352

Value: `u16` in mV, range 3000 .. 4200. SET answers status only.

### Settings CHARGE_FULL_TIMEOUT (0x3/0x53)

Stop charging after this long at a state-of-charge reading of CHARGE_FULL_SOC or more, or as soon as the charger reports STANDBY, whichever comes first (0 = never). The charger cannot end a charge by itself while the instrument runs from the battery. Charging restarts below BATTERY_CHARGE_START.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0353, `SET` = 0x1353

Value: `u16` in min, range 0 .. 1440. SET answers status only.

### Settings CHARGE_FULL_SOC (0x3/0x54)

State-of-charge reading (voltage based) from which the CHARGE_FULL_TIMEOUT timer runs. The reading often tops out at 97..99 % while the instrument runs from the battery, so 100 would never fire; default 97

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0354, `SET` = 0x1354

Value: `u16` in %, range 50 .. 100. SET answers status only.

### Settings AUTO_POWEROFF (0x3/0x60)

Idle time with no encoder input before the instrument powers off (0 = never)

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0360, `SET` = 0x1360

Value: `u16` in s, range 0 .. 65535. SET answers status only.

### Settings ENCODER_COUNTS_PER_DETENT (0x3/0x61)

Raw quadrature transitions per mechanical detent of the rotary encoders

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0361, `SET` = 0x1361

Value: `u16`, range 1 .. 100. SET answers status only.

## Topics

Category 0x5. Verbs: GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE.

Fixed bundles of related values, read or pushed atomically. Interval topics take SUBSCRIBE u32 interval_ms; event topics push when something new exists and ignore the interval (the field must still be present).

| ID | Name | Verbs | Since | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | ENV | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | All environmental sensors |
| 0x01 | STATUS | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | Same payload as System STATE |
| 0x02 | LIVE | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | The live tilt reading with its quality flags, atomically |
| 0x03 | RAW | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | Per-batch (about 40.7/s) unsmoothed tilt and residual, for analysis |
| 0x04 | PHASOR_STREAM | SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | Gapless stream of every 64-cycle batch's raw phasors with a sequence number (about 40.7 pushes/s) |
| 0x05 | SIGNAL_DIAG | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | Per-signal amplitude, peak-to-peak and phase at the ADC pins, and the theoretical tilt each sensor implies (Wyler 20 uV per um/m) |

### Topics ENV (0x5/0x00)

All environmental sensors.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0500, `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3500, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4500. SUBSCRIBE request: `u32 interval_ms` (50 .. 3600000); pushes `[issue_seq][page][response payload]`.

**Response** (14 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | i16 | `bme280_temp` | 0.01 degC |  |
| 2 | u32 | `bme280_pressure` | Pa |  |
| 6 | u16 | `bme280_humidity` | 0.01 %RH |  |
| 8 | u8 | `bme280_ok` |  |  |
| 9 | i16 | `onboard_temp` | 0.01 degC | TMP236 on the board |
| 11 | i16 | `external_temp` | 0.01 degC | LM35 on the external connector |
| 13 | u8 | `external_temp_ok` |  |  |

### Topics STATUS (0x5/0x01)

Same payload as System STATE.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0501, `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3501, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4501. SUBSCRIBE request: `u32 interval_ms` (50 .. 3600000); pushes `[issue_seq][page][response payload]`.

**Response** (15 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `battery_state` |  | 0 normal, 1 low, 2 critical, 3 charging, 4 full |
| 1 | u8 | `battery_soc_pct` | % | state of charge |
| 2 | u16 | `battery_mv` | mV |  |
| 4 | u8 | `usb_connected` |  | USB power present (VBUS) |
| 5 | u8 | `ble_connected` |  |  |
| 6 | u8 | `charging` |  |  |
| 7 | u8 | `force_charging` |  | a forced charge is armed (Commands FORCE_CHARGE) |
| 8 | u8 | `charge_inhibited` |  | charging is inhibited (Commands CHARGE_INHIBIT) |
| 9 | u8 | `rail_3v3_on` |  | switched 3V3 rail (EEPROM, BME280, battery divider) |
| 10 | u8 | `rail_5v_on` |  | 5 V rail (display, analog front end, buzzer) |
| 11 | u8 | `demod_running` |  | the tilt demodulation is running |
| 12 | u8 | `phasor_stream_active` |  | a phasor stream subscription owns the ADC |
| 13 | u8 | `bulk_active` |  | a bulk transfer is active |
| 14 | u8 | `service_mode` |  | the gated commands and calibration writes are unlocked: service mode is active, or the firmware was built with the gate off (then always 1) |

### Topics LIVE (0x5/0x02)

The live tilt reading with its quality flags, atomically. SUBSCRIBE pushes once per new display value (about 4.07/s). THE topic for a level display.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0502, `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3502, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4502. SUBSCRIBE is event driven; request: `u32` (ignored).

**Response** (15 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u16 | `seq` |  | increments with every new display value |
| 2 | u8 | `flags` |  | bit0 valid, bit1 sensor 1 doubtful, bit2 sensor 2 doubtful |
| 3 | f32 | `tilt_s1` | mm/m |  |
| 7 | f32 | `tilt_s2` | mm/m |  |
| 11 | f32 | `tilt_diff` | mm/m | S1 - S2 |

### Topics RAW (0x5/0x03)

Per-batch (about 40.7/s) unsmoothed tilt and residual, for analysis. SUBSCRIBE at 50 ms to follow it essentially 1:1.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0503, `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3503, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4503. SUBSCRIBE request: `u32 interval_ms` (50 .. 3600000); pushes `[issue_seq][page][response payload]`.

**Response** (23 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | f32 | `tilt_s1` | mm/m |  |
| 4 | f32 | `residual_s1` |  | Im(x) quadrature part, near 0 when calibrated |
| 8 | f32 | `tilt_s2` | mm/m |  |
| 12 | f32 | `residual_s2` |  |  |
| 16 | u8 | `window_ok_s1` |  | the newest display window of sensor 1 was not doubtful |
| 17 | u8 | `window_ok_s2` |  |  |
| 18 | f32 | `tilt_diff` | mm/m |  |
| 22 | u8 | `window_ok_diff` |  | both sensors OK |

### Topics PHASOR_STREAM (0x5/0x04)

Gapless stream of every 64-cycle batch's raw phasors with a sequence number (about 40.7 pushes/s). The subscription arms the ADC for the stream; the demodulation keeps running. A gap in `seq` (modulo 65536, step 64) means lost batches. Event topic: the interval field is ignored. Fields are in ADC CHANNEL order S2, B, A, S1 (ch0..ch3; before fw 0.13.0 it was B, A, S1, S2) and are the raw sums, not divided by the channel PGAs (docs/channel-map.md).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3504, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4504. SUBSCRIBE is event driven; request: `u32` (ignored).

**Push payload** (after `[issue_seq][page]`)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | f32 | `iS2` |  | S2 (ADC ch0) |
| 4 | f32 | `qS2` |  |  |
| 8 | f32 | `iB` |  | B (ADC ch1) |
| 12 | f32 | `qB` |  |  |
| 16 | f32 | `iA` |  | A (ADC ch2) |
| 20 | f32 | `qA` |  |  |
| 24 | f32 | `iS1` |  | S1 (ADC ch3) |
| 28 | f32 | `qS1` |  |  |
| 32 | u16 | `seq` |  | cycle counter of the batch's last cycle (steps of 64, wraps at 65536) |

### Topics SIGNAL_DIAG (0x5/0x05)

Per-signal amplitude, peak-to-peak and phase at the ADC pins, and the theoretical tilt each sensor implies (Wyler 20 uV per um/m). **The four values of each group are in ADC CHANNEL order S2, B, A, S1** (ch0..ch3, the same order as the phasor stream, the bulk capture and the LCD; before fw 0.13.0 it was B, A, S1, S2; see docs/channel-map.md). Phase is referenced so that A - B sits at 90 deg (A reads +90, B 270).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0505, `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3505, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4505. SUBSCRIBE request: `u32 interval_ms` (50 .. 3600000); pushes `[issue_seq][page][response payload]`.

**Response** (56 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | f32 | `rms_mv_s2` | mV | S2 (ADC ch0) |
| 4 | f32 | `rms_mv_b` | mV | B (ADC ch1) |
| 8 | f32 | `rms_mv_a` | mV | A (ADC ch2) |
| 12 | f32 | `rms_mv_s1` | mV | S1 (ADC ch3) |
| 16 | f32 | `p2p_mv_s2` | mV | S2 |
| 20 | f32 | `p2p_mv_b` | mV | B |
| 24 | f32 | `p2p_mv_a` | mV | A |
| 28 | f32 | `p2p_mv_s1` | mV | S1 |
| 32 | f32 | `phase_deg_s2` | deg | S2 |
| 36 | f32 | `phase_deg_b` | deg | B, about 270 (A - B = 90 by definition) |
| 40 | f32 | `phase_deg_a` | deg | A, about 90 |
| 44 | f32 | `phase_deg_s1` | deg | S1 |
| 48 | f32 | `theoretical_tilt_s1` | mm/m |  |
| 52 | f32 | `theoretical_tilt_s2` | mm/m |  |

## Debug log

Category 0x6. Verbs: SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE.

The device log, streamed live (Services/svc_log.c).

| ID | Name | Verbs | Since | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | LOG | SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | Log lines of at least the requested severity |

### Debug log LOG (0x6/0x00)

Log lines of at least the requested severity. A subscription flushes the backlog still held on the device first. Each push: [issue_seq][page][severity][text, no terminator, up to 48 bytes].

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3600, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4600. SUBSCRIBE is event driven; request: `u8 min_severity`.

**Push payload** (after `[issue_seq][page]`)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `severity` |  | 0 info, 1 warning, 2 error |
| 1.. | char[] | `text` |  | remainder of the payload |

**Subscribe request**

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `min_severity` |  | 0 info, 1 warning, 2 error |

## Bulk transfers

Category 0x8. Verbs: START_BULK, CANCEL_BULK.

Large RAM-buffered transfers streamed in chunks under the START opcode, paced by the transport's transmit ring.

| ID | Name | Verbs | Since | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | RAW_ADC | START_BULK, CANCEL_BULK | 3.0 | Raw ADC capture: 6144 samples x 4 channels x 24 bit (about 295 ms at 20.83 kHz), packed little-endian signed, ADC channel order ch0 = S2, ch1 = B, ch2 = A, ch3 = S1 (docs/channel-map.md) |

### Bulk transfers RAW_ADC (0x8/0x00)

Raw ADC capture: 6144 samples x 4 channels x 24 bit (about 295 ms at 20.83 kHz), packed little-endian signed, ADC channel order ch0 = S2, ch1 = B, ch2 = A, ch3 = S1 (docs/channel-map.md). After the OK ack the chunks follow: [status][page][10 samples x 12 bytes]. Device-wide exclusive; stops the demodulation for the duration.

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `START_BULK` = 0x5800, `CANCEL_BULK` = 0x6800

**Push payload** (after `[issue_seq][page]`)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `page` |  | wrapping chunk counter |

## Procedures

Category 0x9. Verbs: GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE.

Status and results of multi-second procedures started with a command. GET polls; SUBSCRIBE (u32, ignored) pushes when the phase changes and about every 250 ms while running.

| ID | Name | Verbs | Since | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | ZERO_CAL | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | Flip (zero) calibration status (Commands ZERO_CAL) |
| 0x01 | PRECISION | GET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE | 3.0 | Precision measurement status and result (Commands PRECISION) |

### Procedures ZERO_CAL (0x9/0x00)

Flip (zero) calibration status (Commands ZERO_CAL).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0900, `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3900, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4900. SUBSCRIBE is event driven; request: `u32` (ignored).

**Response** (6 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `phase` |  | 0 idle, 1 step 1 running, 2 step 1 done (turn the instrument), 3 step 2 running, 4 result ready (stored automatically, then back to idle) |
| 1 | u16 | `progress` |  | batches averaged in the current step |
| 3 | u16 | `target` |  |  |
| 5 | u8 | `sensor_mask` |  | sensors covered by the current run |

### Procedures PRECISION (0x9/0x01)

Precision measurement status and result (Commands PRECISION).

Since API 3.0. Verbs: `GET` = 0x0901, `SUBSCRIBE` = 0x3901, `UNSUBSCRIBE` = 0x4901. SUBSCRIBE is event driven; request: `u32` (ignored).

**Response** (23 bytes)

| Offset | Type | Field | Unit | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | `phase` |  | 0 idle, 1 running, 2 done |
| 1 | u16 | `target` |  | window length in batches (81 = 1.99 s) |
| 3 | u16 | `count` |  | contiguous batches collected since the trigger |
| 5 | u32 | `elapsed_ms` |  |  |
| 9 | u8 | `failed` |  | done without a result: no clean window within 5 s |
| 10 | f32 | `tilt_s1` | mm/m | valid when phase == 2 and failed == 0 |
| 14 | f32 | `tilt_s2` | mm/m |  |
| 18 | f32 | `tilt_diff` | mm/m |  |
| 22 | u8 | `disturbed` |  | while running: the newest full window is not clean |
